title: REEL — 3 LATTE ART MISTAKES

brief.audience: Home-coffee fans in Cairo, 20–35, who own a milk frother and post their cups
brief.cta: Save it and come practise at the Saturday latte-art class
brief.scope: episode 1 of a 6-part series 'Barista in 30 seconds'

lines: Top-down: a sad, blobby heart in a cup. Hard cut to Mariam pointing at it.
Your latte art fails because of THIS

blocks.speaker: Mariam
lines: "If your heart looks like a cloud — it's not your hands."

blocks.speaker: Mariam
lines: "Stop at 60 degrees. Hotter milk loses the silky foam you need."
Side view of a jug: thick foam vs glossy 'wet paint' milk, split screen.

blocks.speaker: Mariam
lines: "You want wet paint, not a bubble bath. Swirl it till it shines."

scenes.title: SCENE 04 — MISTAKE 3: POURING FROM TOO HIGH

lines: Slow motion: jug drops close to the cup, white blooms on the surface.

blocks.speaker: Mariam
lines: "Start high to mix, then drop the jug close — that's when the white appears."
Perfect heart, slow push-in. Mariam slides the cup to camera.

blocks.speaker: Mariam
lines: "Save this, and come practise with me Saturday — link in bio."
